original.target_description: Study 3; American MTurk participants; four-condition one-way ANCOVA with political orientation as covariate. Condition comparison in perceived recidivism.

n.sample_role: Participants in target ANCOVA; exact analytic n not explicitly printed for this test.
n.exclusions: 303 recruited; 298 passed comprehension checks. Test-specific missingness not enumerated; 298 is not assumed to be analytic n.
n.quote: we boosted this study’s sample size to 303 American participants from MTurk, with an effective sample size of 298 participants who passed our comprehension check questions

es.quote: Condition did not affect perceived recidivism or intention to kill, Fs < 2.00, ps > .200, η²p s = 0.01.

p.quote: Condition did not affect perceived recidivism or intention to kill, Fs < 2.00, ps > .200, η²p s = 0.01.

replication.target_description: Crawford et al. close replication of Cheung and Heine (2015) Study 3; American MTurk sample; four-condition ANCOVA controlling political ideology; P. recidivism. Author report linked from DOI registration response item36.

n.sample_role: Participants in target ANCOVA; exact test-specific analytic n not explicitly printed.
n.exclusions: Comprehension-check exclusions left a final study sample of 743; test-specific missingness not enumerated. Final study n is not substituted for analytic n.
n.location: DOCX report p. 2, Method, Participants, second paragraph
n.quote: We excluded those participants who failed a comprehension check based on the criteria used by Cheung and Heine (2015), resulting in a final sample size of n = 743 participants

es.location: DOCX replication report, p. 4; Replication Analysis, P. recidivism (paragraph locator)
es.quote: Condition had no effect on perceived recidivism, F(3, 737) = 1.42, p = .24, 2p = .01

p.location: DOCX replication report, p. 4; Replication Analysis, P. recidivism (paragraph locator)
p.quote: Condition had no effect on perceived recidivism, F(3, 737) = 1.42, p = .24, 2p = .01

reported_success.location: DOCX report, Table 1, P. recidivism row, Replicated? column

notes: Primary sources verified by title. Original: author-hosted published PDF. Replication: authors’ full DOCX linked from assigned OSF registration, item36. Effect sizes and p values copied as printed, without correction or conversion. DOCX text parse loses eta glyph (rendered 2p). Original analytic n not inferred from degrees of freedom; replication final sample 743 not assumed to equal each test’s analytic n. Reported success uses outcome-specific author verdict in Table 1; qualified yes verdicts coded mixed.
